publicQuestion: How many Standard Young Tableaux of skew shape λ/μ with λ = (14,13,12,11,9,7,6,5,3,1) and μ = (6,4,2,1) are there? Here μ is contained in λ, the skew diagram λ/μ is obtained by removing the Young diagram of μ from the upper-left corner of that of λ, and a Standard Young Tableau of shape λ/μ is a filling of its 68 cells with the integers 1 through 68 such that entries strictly increase left-to-right along each row and top-to-bottom along each column. Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: The skew shape is fully specified and standard, so the number of SYT is a well-defined exact integer. It can be verified independently by Aitken’s determinantal formula for skew SYT counts or by the recurrence that removes one outer corner at a time from the Ferrers poset.
